environment_setting: Country B, City X, where a major power plant is located, providing electricity to the entire region. Citizens are aware of its importance but some are tempted to interfere for personal or ideological reasons.
norm_base: Citizens Interfering with use/operation of key national infrastructure Up to general limit in magistrates' court, fine, or both; On indictment: Up to 12 months imprisonment, fine, or both

character_profile.name: Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: gain access to the power plant to test a self-designed energy-saving device

legitimate.legitimate_action: Requesting permission to test the device through official channels
legitimate.benefits: Potential approval to test the device legally, gaining recognition for innovation
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming process, potential rejection of the request

illegal.illegal_action: Breaking into the power plant to test the device without authorization
illegal.benefits: Immediate access to test the device, potential success in proving its efficiency
illegal.costs: Up to 12 months imprisonment, fine, or both if caught; risk of damaging critical infrastructure

character_profile.name: Jordan Lee
character_profile.goal: ensure the power plant operates safely and sustainably

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising Alex to follow proper channels for testing the device
legitimate.benefits: Maintains safety and security of the power plant, avoids legal issues
legitimate.costs: May not convince Alex, risking his illegal actions

illegal.illegal_action: Helping Alex gain unauthorized access to the power plant
illegal.benefits: Supports Alex's innovation, potential success of the device
illegal.costs: Up to 12 months imprisonment, fine, or both if caught; professional reputation damage

character_profile.name: Chris Morgan
character_profile.profession: security guard at the power plant

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting any suspicious activity to the authorities
legitimate.benefits: Maintains job security, ensures safety of the power plant
legitimate.costs: Effort required to monitor and report, potential conflict with Alex

illegal.illegal_action: Accepting a bribe from Alex to allow unauthorized access
illegal.benefits: Earns extra money from the bribe
illegal.costs: Up to 12 months imprisonment, fine, or both if caught; loss of job
